derived_map_metrics.note: All values in Unity units (= meters). Each cites the player metric it comes from. 'min/max' = hard engine limit; 'recommended' = comfortable design value.

min_ceiling_clearance_standing_u.from: crouch.stand_up_clearance_check.implied_standing_headroom_u (CheckSphere 1.4+0.6). Below 2.0u the player is forced to stay crouched.

min_crouch_tunnel_height_u.from: crouch.ducked_controller_height_u = 0.9 + skin/margin. A tunnel 1.0-1.1u tall is passable only while crouched (and correctly blocks standing since it is < 2.0u).

door_passage_height_u.from: same 2.0u standing clearance. Doorways/arches you can run through standing must be >= 2.0u tall.

door_passage_width_u.from: player.controller_diameter_u = 1.0 (2 x radius 0.5) + 2 x skin 0.2. Absolute minimum opening ~1.0-1.1u; use >=1.4u so players don't snag.

min_corridor_width_u.from: player diameter 1.0u. 1.1u = single-file squeeze; ~2.0u lets a player strafe/dodge; 3-4u for main routes where two players cross.

max_step_up_ledge_u.from: player.step_offset_u = 0.415. Ledges/stairs up to ~0.41u are auto-climbed by walking; anything taller needs a jump. Keep individual stair risers <= 0.4u.

max_walkable_ramp_angle_deg.from: player.slope_limit_deg = 70. Ramps <= 70 deg are walkable; steeper faces block/slide. Use <= 45 deg for comfortable run-up ramps.

max_jumpable_gap_flat_u.from: jump.run_jump_horizontal_reach_u. Gaps at equal floor height should be <= ~4.0u to be run-jumpable; make intentionally impassable gaps >= ~5u.

max_jumpable_step_up_u.from: jump.jump_height_u = 2.25. A ledge/platform up to ~2.25u above the floor can be reached with a standing jump (feet clear it); make climbable platforms <= 2.0u of vertical rise, or stagger them.

crouch_cover_height_u.from: crouched capsule top ~1.0u above floor (crouch.ducked geometry) vs standing head ~1.6u. Cover ~1.0-1.1u tall hides a CROUCHED player but a STANDING player can shoot over it. Classic 'crouch behind, peek by standing' cover.

chest_high_cover_height_u.from: between crouch head (~1.0u) and standing eye (~1.55u). ~1.1-1.3u cover blocks a standing player's torso while leaving the head exposed to peek/shoot over.

stand_cover_height_u.from: standing capsule top ~1.6u / eye ~1.55u (player geometry). Cover must be >= ~1.6u to fully conceal a standing player; use 1.8-2.0u walls for reliable full cover.
